_readme: Control centre › Systems reads this file. Keep it up to date whenever a system changes stage. Plain words – the owners read it. ‘All systems’ shows what is RUNNING (live, test, broken, off); ‘Planned’ shows what isn't running yet (build, planned, parked). status: live = guests/staff use it now · test = running, still being checked · build = being built · planned = decided, not started · parked = idea on the shelf · off = switched off/retired · broken = should work but doesn't.

items.name: SimplyBook phone alerts
items.what: Push alerts in the SimplyBook app stopped on every phone on 29 Oct, 5:50pm – also for bookings on SimplyBook's own page. Logging out/in didn't help. Ask SimplyBook support.

items.name: Mirror rooms (Atlas ↔ Vale blocks)
items.what: Since 11 Nov 2026 run by the booking engine instead of Make (Make [BACKEND] SYSTEM BLOCKS MIRROR ROOMS switched off 11 Nov, 8:18pm). When Atlas or Vale is booked (online, by staff or in SimplyBook), a SYSTEM BLOCK booking goes in the other room for the same time, cleaning included; it moves and cancels with the booking. Works for every service (same kind – off-peak / peak / early bird – in the twin, else its off-peak service). If a block can't be made, staff get a phone alert. Switch: engine gm mirror do=on / off (off = back to Make, which would need switching on again).

items.name: Noise rule (Max/Atlas 4+ → Bella, Bella 4 → Atlas)
items.what: A session with 4 or more guests in Max or Atlas blocks Bella for the same time (with cleaning and extensions); 4 guests in Bella blocks Atlas. Max is never blocked. Works for online bookings, SimplyBook bookings (guest count field) and control-centre sessions ("4 pax" in the note). The block shows in SimplyBook as “SYSTEM BLOCK · NOISE” and goes away by itself when the session is cancelled, shortened or drops below 4 guests. If the other room is already booked, the booking still goes ahead and staff get an alert (phone + Telegram).
items.runs: booking engine (Cloudflare) · on every SimplyBook change, after In session / Add a session, every 10 min (tonight + tomorrow), hourly (week ahead)

items.name: Confirmation email link (TV message)
items.what: A line in SimplyBook's confirmation email (book.round2.sg/b/<booking code>) opens the guest's booking page. Pasted into the template and tested by the owner 9 Nov; Round2-styled email pictures added 10 Nov.

items.name: Online rescheduling
items.what: BETA, live 12 Nov 2026. Guests move their own booking from their booking page (book.round2.sg/b/<code> › Reschedule, or the MANAGE YOUR BOOKING button in the emails). Rules: up to 2 moves; 3+ days ahead any free slot; under 3 days new times from 2:15pm; under 24h same-day upgrades only; under 3h no rescheduling; new time at least 3h away; free in the first 15 min after booking or a move. Fee: MOVE $15, or UPGRADE / PEAK TIME $5 (they pay the price difference too), plus POPULAR +$5 to +$20 in $5 steps; some popular slots $5 OFF; 2nd move +$10; early-bird bookings always $15. Paid on HitPay; the move happens only after payment, with a fresh check that the time is still free (if not, staff are alerted to move or refund). The page and the engine use the very same rules file, so the price shown is the price charged. Cheaper slots: no refund. Calendar read from SimplyBook once and kept 3 minutes, so it doesn't eat the SimplyBook limit. Switch: engine mode gResched=false turns it off (guests then see 'WhatsApp us'). The way in is the booking link only (email button or the link staff send); a homepage LOAD SAVE / SAVE FOUND was tried 12 Nov and removed (a forwarded link would show on another phone). 14 Nov: adding hours to the same slot has no change fee (only the extra hours) and doesn't use a move; $5 only for a bigger kind of room or a dearer rate. While a guest pays, the new time is held 10 minutes like a new booking (ONLINE HOLD note in SimplyBook).

items.name: Move a booking (staff)
items.what: Control centre › Bookings › Move a booking (12 Nov). Staff pick a booking, a new room/day/time (only free times shown), and see the fee in two parts: the move (Move $15, or Upgrade / Peak time $5 + the price difference) plus Popular time +$10/+$20 when the slot is in demand (Vale/Atlas straight after a session in the same room +$10). Staff can lower or waive it (reason logged). Payment: PayNow QR on the screen, a HitPay link for WhatsApp, or Paid in shop (Tap to Pay). The move is a SimplyBook edit; the Vale/Atlas block, TV messages and wrap-up messages follow; the guest's booking page shows the new time. Bookings › Rescheduling lists every move. A booking's +h (EXT) extension moves with it (12 Nov). Since 12 Nov the popular-time part goes in $5 steps (+$5 to +$20), same as the guest page.

items.name: Round2 addresses for guest links (round2.sg)
items.what: Since 31 Oct guests see round2.sg addresses, not 'donttelldadyet': booking confirmation after paying and 'View your booking' → book.round2.sg (/done, /find, /b/<code>); room food menu → menu.round2.sg/<room> (e.g. menu.round2.sg/vale). TV message links were already cue.round2.sg. DNS stays in Wix (CNAME book / menu → donttelldadyet-prog.github.io); domain registered at Vodien. Old links still work. Still to do: owner points each room's Wix links page (valelinks etc.) at menu.round2.sg/<room>; the SimplyBook confirmation-email line should use book.round2.sg/b/<code>.

items.name: Booking page safety (HitPay is the truth)
items.what: A time is never let go without asking HitPay; a paid booking is always made (Malia, 5 Nov). Payment pages close when the guest's 10 minutes end; a 5-minute check books anyone who paid but isn't booked.

items.name: Booking page numbers
items.what: Control centre › Website › Booking page: how long guests take to pay, latest attempts with the session date (Fri 6 Nov, 11am), sorted by Paid / why they left before paying (came back from paying, changed their mind, 10 minutes ran out, picked another time, checkout error) / booked by hand. Reasons are noted since 5 Nov.

items.name: Membership (3 / 6 / 12 months)
items.what: One member per phone number (the booker; group saves sit under them). Pitched at That's a wrap with the guest's own game and time played. Draft prices: 3 months S$15, 6 months S$25, 12 months S$30 'Best value' (pre-selected); each gives the same amount back as booking credit ('pays for itself on your next visit'). One-off payment via HitPay + renewal reminder; no auto-renew at first. Lapsed: saves frozen ~3 months, then deleted. Prices not final – watch sign-ups, plan picked and return visits for a month.
items.runs: Booking engine (members table) + sign-up page + control centre › Members (owner key)
items.code: not started · plan in chat 5 Nov 2026

items.name: Guest game saves (PS4)
items.what: Members continue their PS4 games on a later visit, in any room. One membership = up to 2 personal PS4 profiles (member + partner) next to the room's main profile. At login their profiles appear with their saves; at session end the saves go to the cloud and the profiles are removed. Non-members: their saves are parked (kept, tied to the booking) so they can still be given back if the guest signs up; the next guest starts clean. Never touched: Gran Turismo Sport's save in Max's main profile (fully unlocked – the racing-sim draw). Saves prepared on each PS4 ahead of the day's bookings so a dropped internet connection can't block a login.
items.runs: Round2 PS4 helper (round2d, on every room PS4) · booking engine · Cloudflare storage (bucket round2-saves)
items.code: round2-tv-launcher branch ps4-helper folder ps4/ · round2sg-home worker/round2-book.js (ps4*) · full log: project doc ps4-game-saves.md

items.name: Game saves – proven so far (13–14 Nov 2026)
items.what: All done remotely by the helper on Max: rename a spare profile; sign a profile in and out; open a save decrypted (read-only); back a save up to the cloud; restore it into another profile (Gran Turismo Sport, Max → User4, checked on the TV by the owner); put the PS4 into rest mode. Saves load in profiles that are not activated. The real game data is small (KBs to ~32 MB).
items.runs: Staff actions ps4prof, ps4look (/_save, /_sback, /_srest, /_rest), ps4saves · System check step 'PS4 helpers + game-save storage'

items.name: Game saves – still to build, in order
items.what: 1) Restore between a 9.00 and an 11.00 PS4. 2) Restore into a profile that has no save for that game yet. 3) Check each game is the same version in every room. 4) Member profile from start to end (name → sign in → restore → play → back up → sign out → remove). 5) Parking non-members' saves; clean slate through the PS4's own delete. 6) Back up during the session + a to-do list on the PS4 that survives rest mode (test: rest mode in the middle of a job). 7) Prepare the day's saves from the bookings. 8) Guest login on the PS4 (QR). 9) Morning wake-up of booked rooms (TV on → PS4 wakes; to check at the shop). Saves filed by member, not by PS4, so a second outlet works.
items.runs: PS4 helper + engine; owner at a PS4 for the checks on the TV

items.name: Game saves – later: other branches / PC room
items.what: Works across branches if every PS4 uses the same Apollo account ID and the engine gets a branch label. A Steam Machine / PC room would keep its own set of saves (Steam Cloud off, Ludusavi + our upload) – check game licences for commercial use first. Only when a second branch is found.

items.what: Birthday, '10 minutes left', 'that's a wrap' etc. from TV messages › Round2 messages. Each message is tagged by who made it: gold ROUND2 (by hand, +1h, Late session), blue ⚙ AUTO WRAP-UP, grey GUEST. Messages 12am–6am count as the night before.

items.name: Guest messages (cue.round2.sg)
items.what: Guests write their own TV message from a link; staff approve; it pops up on time. Each link is tied to its booking or note when made (moved → moves, deleted → cancelled); a link made first waits and ties itself, Late session ties it straight away, Pair fixes a wrong time, and a phone heads-up comes 3 h before if it's still not tied (2 Nov).

items.name: Message timer
items.what: Sends each queued message to its TV a minute before its time.
items.runs: Booking engine (replaced Make's GUEST MESSAGE TIMER, now off)

items.name: Messages follow their booking
items.what: When staff move a booking in SimplyBook (new time, day or room), its guest message moves too; if the booking is cancelled, the message is cancelled. Happens the moment SimplyBook reports the change (and is checked again right before the message shows). Moving a message by hand still works and isn't undone.

items.name: In session: extend a session (+1/+2/+3h)
items.what: Control centre › In session shows today's bookings and notes per room – after 5pm also tonight's after-midnight sessions. +1h/+2h/+3h: a booking or ordinary note gets ONE EXT note after it ('EXT till 1am · Amanda'), stretched on each +1h; a Late session note is stretched itself and its text changed ('late till 2am'). Vale/Atlas: the twin gets a SYSTEM BLOCK. Moves or adds 'About 10 minutes to go' / 'That's a wrap!', TV shows '+N CREDITS ADDED'. Undo for 30 min.

items.name: Add a session (was Late session)
items.what: Since 12 Nov: a daytime session (start 11am–8:15pm, guest leaves by 11:15pm, 3–6 whole hours, nothing in the way) with the guest's MOBILE becomes a REAL SimplyBook booking: its own contact (the name typed), pax, Vale/Atlas twin blocked, and a booking-page link to copy or WhatsApp to the guest (TV message, receipt, rescheduling). Email is optional – with it, the guest also gets the confirmation email. Everything else (late, other lengths, clashes, no mobile, Change) stays a note as before. In session › Add a session, or its own Home Screen button (staff.round2.sg/late/). Key in a WhatsApp or walk-in session, also past midnight, in 15-min steps: one SimplyBook note with name and pax, clash check first, optional wrap-up messages (untick = none, Auto wrap-up skips it too). TESTING (owner, 2 Nov): the form asks for “Night of” + arrival (times after 12am show their real date, a red box confirms it; before 7am the page opens on last night). Waiting for the admin's feedback: keep “Night of”, or pick the real date instead? (Out of testing 11 Nov 2026.)

items.name: Upcoming sessions keyed in here (change / cancel)
items.what: Under Add a session: everything keyed in there (and other notes that start before 7am or run past midnight), 45 days ahead; 🌙 Late only on sessions late by their times (from 11pm, or past 11:15pm). Change (time, night, room) or Cancel (tap twice) – the note, its TV messages and its SimplyBook label follow. Real bookings are changed in SimplyBook.

items.name: Alert history
items.what: Home › Alert history: every phone alert of the last 24 hours (rolling, so overnight bookings are still there in the morning); problems stay until marked sorted; tap one for its details page (swipe from the left edge to go back). Home shows a one-line Last 24 hours summary. New-booking alerts say 🆕 1st visit or 🔁 Nth visit (matched by phone or email over all bookings since Sep 2025; kept up to date with each booking and cancellation). Pages are kept 3 days so a late-tapped notification still opens.

items.name: After-midnight labels in SimplyBook
items.what: SimplyBook only shows 11am–12am. A session starting after 12am gets '↓ AFTER 12AM · name · times' at 11:30pm the night before; one running past 12am gets '↓ TILL 1AM · name'. Labels block nothing and nothing reads them; they follow every change.
items.runs: Booking engine (every 30 min + on each change)

items.name: Auto wrap-up
items.what: Switch in TV messages › Auto wrap-up (on since 2 Nov). Every session today gets 'About 10 minutes to go' and 'That's a wrap!' by itself, kept in step with new bookings, extensions, moves and cancellations; uses messages already set by hand instead of doubling; one session can be switched off. Switching off removes everything it scheduled; hand-made ones stay. (Out of testing 11 Nov 2026.)
items.runs: Booking engine – as Round2 messages (blue ⚙ tag)

items.name: Clean-up of orphan wrap-up messages
items.what: Every 10 min and when SimplyBook reports a change: a '10 minutes to go' / 'That's a wrap!' whose booking or note no longer exists is cancelled (max 4 at once, as a safety stop).

items.name: Food alerts on the TV
items.what: 'Order locked in' and 'Loot dropped' on the room's TV.

items.name: TV tiles say what's on screen
items.what: Round2 messages › On the TVs now shows what each TV has in front (PS4, YouTube, Round2 menu…) and for how long. Built 2 Nov (TV app 1.0.225); each TV shows it once it's updated. Same update fixes LG TVs reporting the wrong message as 'shown'. (Out of testing 11 Nov 2026.)

items.name: Remote TV updates (Update now from the control centre)
items.what: Built 2 Nov (TV app 1.0.226; works on a TV once it has 1.0.226). Update now on each TV tile (Round2 messages › On the TVs now), refused while the TV is off, locked in its Staff tools, or its room has a session now or within 10 min. LG installs by itself (download + SHA-256 check first, 'don't switch off' notice, progress on the tile, reinstalls itself on start-up if cut off). Android only gets it ready – staff press Install in Staff tools › Update app. (Out of testing 11 Nov 2026.)

items.name: TV messages: Tonight / Send / Guest links / Calendar + TVs tab
items.what: Built 2 Nov (owner's Plan A). Tonight = every message tonight (guest, Round2, Auto wrap-up) per room and booking, finished bookings folded away; Send = the form only; Guest links = make + list on one page; Calendar = later days. TVs tab = status tiles + Update now + Test a TV; Home shows 'x of 7 TVs on'. (Out of testing 11 Nov 2026.)

items.name: Smoother transitions
items.what: Owner is thinking it over (2 Nov). Ideas, best first: 1) pause the background while a transition plays (test on one LG first); 2) Rise moves the menu as one piece instead of ~15 parts; 3) each TV checks its own smoothness at start-up and switches itself to Fade if it drops frames ('lite mode' on its TV tile); 4) open the app at the same moment as the animation (with 3). Warp, Flash and Lightning + ship were removed 2 Nov for being heavy/unused.
